name: Mark Berskii
source:
He may be the quietest person in the room, but Mark lets his music speak for itself. As the Ultimate Music Producer, Mark takes the best sounds of the musicians he works with, mixes them together, and ends up with a derivative piece of art that perfectly encapsulates the emotion he wants the listener to feel. He often uses his musical talent to substitute for his lack of social interaction, always preferring to stay of of the spotlight.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1353393619722510338]official description[/url]]
